source.body:
Hello n8n Support,

I'm experiencing an issue with the Hosted Chat interface on my n8n Cloud instance, running version 2.45.5.

The hosted chat works perfectly on desktop, but mobile users receive a completely blank white screen. No chat header, messages or input field appear.

Troubleshooting completed:

Removed all custom CSS and reverted to default styling.

Tested in private browsing mode.

Confirmed the issue across multiple mobile devices.

Created a separate test workflow with a new Hosted Chat trigger, which also displayed a blank screen on my iPhone.

Confirmed the original workflow continues working on desktop.

The chat is publicly available, uses Hosted Chat mode and requires no authentication.

Could you investigate whether this is a mobile frontend compatibility issue or a problem with the hosted chat assets on my Cloud instance?

I can provide the affected Chat URLs and screenshots.

Many thanks,
FutureGrow
